With that said, his overall upside is limited, particularly if he is playing no more than about 25 minutes per night.

news.headline: Poole finished with 14 points (5-8 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 2-4 FT), an assist and a block across 21 minutes in Wednesday's 145-111 loss to the Nets.
news.story: Poole made efficient use of his limited offensive opportunities, but his 21-minute workload and minimal secondary contributions limited his fantasy production. Poole's scoring ability provides occasional upside, but his inconsistent playing time and narrow statistical profile outside of the scoring column make him difficult to trust in standard formats.

news.headline: Poole posted seven points (1-5 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 4-4 FT), three rebounds, two assists and one block over 34 minutes during Monday's 138-87 loss to Golden State.
news.story: Poole logged a team-high 34 minutes but managed only five shot attempts and finished with a game-worst minus-47 rating. His heavy workload came largely in garbage time of a blowout. news.story: Dybantsa struggled with his efficiency, making just six of his 18 field-goal attempts as Washington suffered its seventh straight defeat. The rookie continues to receive substantial offensive opportunities despite his inconsistency, which is encouraging for his long-term development. However, his fantasy production still depends heavily on scoring volume. He's averaging 15.1 points, 6.2 rebounds and 2.2 assists per…

news.headline: Dybantsa posted 21 points (8-17 FG, 1-4 3Pt, 4-6 FT), eight rebounds, one assist and two blocks across 37 minutes during Monday's 122-111 loss to the Pistons.
news.story: Dybantsa was Washington's second-leading scorer, and his rebounding and shot-blocking added to a solid line. However, his five turnovers were the downside. The rookie is seeing a heavy workload, and his scoring volume gives him plenty of fantasy appeal as he adjusts to the NBA.

news.headline: Dybantsa posted 19 points (7-15 FG, 1-5 3Pt, 4-6 FT), six rebounds and three assists across 31 minutes in Saturday's 114-75 loss to the Thunder.
news.story: Dybantsa led Washington in scoring despite the lopsided result and reached double-digit scoring numbers for the fifth time in his first six NBA contests. The rookie's workload remains encouraging, though efficiency and secondary contributions will determine his consistency. He's scoring 16.0 points per game but shooting just 42.5 percent from the field, including 27.8 percent from three.

news.headline: Bane fouled out of Friday's 107-99 victory over Milwaukee after recording 21 points (7-13 FG, 6-10 3Pt, 1-1 FT), five rebounds, three assists and two steals across 35 minutes.
news.story: Bane turned in an efficient performance, particularly from beyond the arc, finishing as Orlando's second-leading scorer. Additionally, he tied his season high in steals. The 28-year-old wing has reached the 20-point mark in three of his last five outings, averaging 19.2 points, 4.6 rebounds, 2.4 assists and 0.8 steals in 34.6 minutes per showing during that span.

news.headline: Desmond Bane gets the basket plus the foul
Bane ended Wednesday's 123-108 win over the Jazz with 25 points (9-16 FG, 7-11 3Pt), three rebounds, two assists and one steal over 34 minutes.
news.story: The seven made three-pointers were a season high for Bane, while the 25 points were his best showing so far in November. Through 10 games this season, the 28-year-old wing is averaging 18.0 points, 4.0 boards, 3.9 threes, 2.4 assists and 1.4 combined steals and blocks, and his 10.0 three-point attempts a contest is nearly double last season's 5.2 mark.

Giddey's free-throw shooting remains a weakness, but his contributions in multiple categories make him particularly valuable…

news.headline: Poole posted seven points (1-5 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 4-4 FT), three rebounds, two assists and one block over 34 minutes during Monday's 138-87 loss to Golden State.

opp_injuries.note: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

news.headline: Lillard posted 29 points (6-18 FG, 6-13 3Pt, 11-11 FT), two rebounds and six assists across 33 minutes during Friday's 120-107 win over the Kings.
news.story: The veteran added 29 points despite an inefficient night from inside the arc, making up for it by hitting six threes and going 11-for-11 at the charity stripe. With Ja Morant (hamstring) out, Lillard has excelled, getting the job done from beyond the arc and continuing to look like his old self. Portland has now won three straight to open its six-game road trip.

news.headline: Clingan contributed 13 points (6-13 FG, 1-4 3Pt), 11 rebounds, two assists, two blocks and two steals across 27 minutes during Friday's 120-107 win over the Kings.
news.story: Clingan posted a double-double while adding two blocks. The young center wasn't as efficient as usual, but his size made a difference in the paint, especially against Domantas Sabonis. Clingan will have a tough matchup in Minnesota early next week.

news.headline: Portland Trail Blazers vs. Sacramento Kings: Game Highlights
Clingan totaled seven points (3-6 FG, 1-2 3Pt), 13 rebounds, three assists and two blocks over 26 minutes during Tuesday's 123-103 win over Oklahoma City.
news.story: Clingan didn't score much, but he controlled the glass and protected the rim against an undersized Thunder frontcourt. That's exactly the role Portland needs from him, and he'll be a matchup problem for Oklahoma City again Wednesday.

opp_injuries.note: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

news.headline: Denver Nuggets vs. New Orleans Pelicans: Game Highlights
Murray popped off for 30 points (12-19 FG, 4-7 3Pt, 2-3 FT), four rebounds, eight assists and two blocks over 32 minutes in Wednesday's 123-118 win over Memphis.
news.story: Murray got off to a bit of a slow start, but he caught fire late, scoring 22 of his 30 points over the final 12:38. This was his second straight 30-plus-point performance and his third consecutive game with just one turnover.
